title: Study Notes on Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction (2nd Ed.)
description:
Independent personal study notes accompanying Richard S. Sutton and Andrew G. Barto's Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction (2nd ed., MIT Press, 2018, licensed CC BY-NC-ND 2.0).

Written in original prose across Chapters 1 through 13 with original Python algorithm implementations and 9 programmatically generated diagrams, built with Quarto as HTML, PDF, EPUB 3.3, and a native MathJax Anki cloze deck. Intended as a companion for study and review, not a substitute for the textbook.
notes: Original independent study notes and programmatically generated diagrams (CC BY 4.0); scripts and Python snippets licensed MIT. Does not include textbook prose, figures, or algorithm listings from Sutton & Barto (2018).
